## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or documentation improvement.

## Related issue

Link an issue if applicable. Use `Closes #123` only when this PR resolves it.

## Testing

Describe the checks performed and their results. Note any checks not run and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and relevant.
- [ ] Existing functionality remains intact.
- [ ] Tests have been run where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if needed.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive information are included.
